title: On strongly G-regular rings
summary: A noetherian ring is called G-regular when all finitely generated Gorenstein projective modules are projective. In this paper, we study rings satisfying the stronger condition that all Gorenstein projective modules are projective, which we call strongly G-regular. We show that the notion of strongly G-regular rings is closely related to that of quasi-dominant rings introduced by Takahashi and to the covariant/contravariant finiteness of a certain thick subcategory.
